title: Chromatin Endogenous Cleavage and High-Throughput Sequencing (ChEC-seq) in S. cerevisiae
author: Gabe Zentner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bgthjwj6
materials: Briefly air-dry pellets and resuspend in 29 µL Qiagen EB or comparable buffer + 1 µL 10 mg/mL RNase A and incubate at 37°C for 10 min.

Briefly air-dry pellets and resuspend in 25 µL Qiagen EB or comparable buffer. Recovered DNA can be quantified by Qubit and the size distribution analyzed via TapeStation using a high-sensitivity tape. Sequencing libraries can be prepared using any standard ChIP-seq-style method.

steps.title: Inoculate starter culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 3 mL YPD or SC medium with a single colony and grow overnight at 30 °C.

steps.title: Dilute and grow to mid‑log
steps.instruction: Dilute the overnight culture to OD₆₀₀ = 0.2–0.3 in 50 mL YPD or SC medium in a 300 mL flask and grow at 30 °C until OD₆₀₀ = 0.5–0.7.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells in a 50 mL conical tube by centrifugation at 1,500 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash cells three times
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with 1 mL Buffer A, transferring the cells to a 1.5 mL tube after the first wash and centrifuging at 1,500 × g for 1 min between washes.

steps.title: Permeabilize with digitonin
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 600 µL Buffer A + 0.1 % digitonin (add 30 µL 2 % digitonin in DMSO to 570 µL Buffer A) and incubate at 30 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect zero‑timepoint sample
steps.instruction: Remove 100 µL of the permeabilized suspension as the zero‑timepoint sample before proceeding to digestion.

steps.title: Extract nucleic acids (first fraction)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol, mix well, and centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 min in a microfuge. Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube, add 2 µL (10 µg) linear acrylamide and 500 µL 100 % ethanol, mix, and precipitate at –80 °C for ≥30 min.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL 20 mg/mL proteinase K and incubate at 55 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Spin and ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed at 4 °C for 10 min, discard supernatant, wash the pellet with 1 mL 75 % ethanol and aspirate the ethanol.

steps.title: Optional gel check
steps.instruction: Run 5 µL of the RNase‑treated DNA on a 1.5 % agarose gel to assess DNA fragmentation.

steps.title: Dilute DNA to 200 µL
steps.instruction: Dilute the RNase‑treated DNA to a final volume of 200 µL using Qiagen EB buffer or an equivalent buffer.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Ampure beads
steps.instruction: Add 160 µL Ampure beads (0.8 : 1 beads:sample ratio), pipet up and down 10 times to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min.

steps.title: Collect beads on magnetic rack
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a magnetic rack for 2 min to capture the beads.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to NaCl tube
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant (~400 µL) and transfer it to a new tube containing 16 µL 5 M NaCl (≈200 mM final concentration).

steps.title: Extract DNA from unbound fraction
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol, mix well, and centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 min in a microfuge.

steps.title: Precipitate unbound DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the aqueous phase to a new tube, add 2 µL (10 µg) linear acrylamide and 1 mL 100 % ethanol, mix, and precipitate at –80 °C for ≥30 min.

steps.title: Spin and wash unbound DNA
steps.instruction: Spin at maximum speed at 4 °C for 10 min, wash the pellet with 1 mL 75 % ethanol, and remove ethanol using a vacuum concentrator.

steps.title: Add calcium for MNase activation
steps.instruction: Add 1.1 µL 1 M CaCl₂ (≈2 mM final), mix, and incubate at 30 °C.

steps.title: Collect time‑point aliquots
steps.instruction: At each desired time point, remove a 100 µL aliquot of the digest and add it to a tube containing 90 µL stop solution and 10 µL 10 % SDS; vortex to mix.

steps.title: Align reads to sacCer3
steps.instruction: Align paired‑end Illumina FASTQ files to the sacCer3 genome using Bowtie 2 with parameters –I 10 –X 700 –‑no‑unal –‑no‑mixed –‑no‑discordant –‑dovetail.

steps.title: Convert SAM to BAM
steps.instruction: Convert the Bowtie 2 SAM output to BAM format using SAMtools.

steps.title: Generate bigWig coverage tracks
steps.instruction: Use deepTools bamCoverage to create single‑base resolution bigWig files with –bs 1, CPM normalization (‑‑normalizeUsing CPM), and extension to the paired‑end fragment length (‑e).

steps.title: Optional downstream analyses
steps.instruction: Merge samples with SAMtools merge as needed, then perform typical ChIP‑seq analyses such as peak calling with MACS2 and motif discovery with MEME or HOMER.
